title: Form Factor Alphabets and Antipodal Duality from Cluster Algebras
summary: We develop a cluster-algebraic description of symbol alphabets for chiral stress-tensor form factors in planar $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory. Motivated by unfolding the three-point $C_2$ quiver, we propose a periodic framework for $n$-point form-factor alphabets based on folding a $\mathrm{Gr}(4,2n)$ quiver with two periods of frozen nodes. At four points, the folding leads to the $\widetilde{\mathrm{VI}}$ cluster algebra, which has infinitely many cluster variables.
